paper_metadata.title: Balancing the fracture toughness and tensile strength by multiple additions of Zr and Y in Nb–Si based alloys

evidence.quote: To obtain the balanced mechanical properties of Nb–Si based alloys, the effects of multiple additions of Zr and Y on microstructure, fracture toughness and tensile strength were investigated.

When forming ahead of the crack tips, the microcracks could absorb partial energy of main cracks propagation, which actually increases the required energy of cracks propagation, reduces the stress concentration at the crack tip and restrains the propagation of cracks.
the unbroken ductile Nbss ahead of crack tips can work as the crack bridging which is one of the most important extrinsic mechanisms
